05 · The unit trap, self-served
What compute costs
One market price, two honest units, indexed to 2026. Per frontier chip of the era it holds its ground, because each era's chip packs more capability; per fixed unit of capability (one H100e, an H100-equivalent) it collapses. Flip the toggle and decide which sentence you were reading in the news.
